configuration.title: Codex 会话通知 / Session Notifier

codexNotifier.notificationsEnabled.description: 启用提醒。关闭时仍保存通知历史。 / Enable alerts. Turning this off still records notification history.

codexNotifier.desktopNotifications.description: 在 Windows 显示系统托盘通知。系统勿扰可能抑制显示。 / Show Windows desktop notifications. Do Not Disturb may suppress them.

codexNotifier.sound.description: 播放 Windows 系统提示音。 / Play the Windows notification sound.

codexNotifier.taskbarAttention.description: 在 Windows 任务栏显示黄色／红色待处理标记，并在窗口预览标题前显示状态。首次使用会为窗口标题模板添加通知变量；已读后自动清除标记。 / Show yellow/red taskbar attention and a status prefix in window preview titles. Adds a title variable on first use; read notifications clear the indicator.

codexNotifier.blinkWindowTitle.description: 未读时让窗口预览标题的状态圆点每 0.8 秒交替显示彩色和浅色，标为已读后停止。不播放声音，不切换焦点。 / Alternate the unread title dot every 0.8 seconds until read. Does not play sound, steal focus or flash the whole thumbnail background.

codexNotifier.notifyOnDone.description: 本轮回复结束时提醒。 / Notify when the current response ends.

codexNotifier.notifyOnApproval.description: 等待批准时提醒。需要配置并信任审批 hook。 / Notify when approval is required. Requires a configured and trusted approval hook.

codexNotifier.notifyOnQuestion.description: 检测到结构化提问工具调用时提醒。 / Notify when a structured question tool call is detected.

codexNotifier.onlyWhenUnfocused.description: 仅当前 VS Code 窗口在后台时发出提醒；前台更新仍进入历史。 / Alert only while the window is in the background; foreground events still enter history.

codexNotifier.autoReadOnWindowFocus.description: 默认关闭：切回窗口不改变未读，点击通知仅标读该条。开启后，手动切回窗口会标读该窗口全部已有提醒，切换会话编辑器标签会标读对应会话；通知主动跳转期间不批量标读。 / Off by default: returning to a window preserves unread state, and a notification click reads only that item. When enabled, manually returning to a window reads all existing window reminders; switching conversation editor tabs reads that session. Notification navigation suspends bulk acknowledgement.

enumDescriptions: Codex 插件会话侧栏（默认） / Codex session sidebar (default)
中间主编辑器区域 / Main editor area
codexNotifier.openLocation.description: 点击通知后在哪里打开对应会话。侧栏跳转会先聚焦目标窗口，再请求 Codex 打开会话；若窗口焦点改变则保留未读。 / Where notification clicks open the session. Sidebar mode focuses the target window before requesting the Codex session; a detected focus change preserves unread state.

codexNotifier.localCodexHome.description: VS Code 本地文件夹中 Codex 的配置目录；留空使用 CODEX_HOME 或 ~/.codex。仅采集 VS Code 插件会话。 / Codex home for local VS Code folders. Empty uses CODEX_HOME, then ~/.codex. Only VS Code-origin sessions are collected.

codexNotifier.localPythonPath.description: 本机 Python 可执行文件路径，不含参数；留空使用 py -3。 / Local Python executable, without arguments. Empty uses py -3.

codexNotifier.localSourceLabel.description: 本地 VS Code 窗口的通知来源名称。 / Source label for notifications from local VS Code windows.

codexNotifier.localCollectorEnabled.description: 在受信任的本地文件夹中采集 VS Code Codex 插件会话；SSH／容器窗口不会启动本地采集。 / Collect VS Code Codex sessions in trusted local folders. SSH/container windows do not start local collection.

codexNotifier.soundOnDone.description: 本轮回复结束时播放声音，默认开启。点击通知或标读仍静音；本轮结束不代表整个项目或后台任务完成。 / Play sound when a response ends (on by default). Clicking and acknowledging are silent. Response completion does not mean the overall goal or a background job has finished.

codexNotifier.desktopOnDone.description: 本轮回复结束时显示 Windows 系统弹窗；默认只保留颜色和未读。审批与提问仍按总弹窗开关提醒。 / Show a Windows desktop notification when a response ends. Off by default; color, unread state and sound remain available. Approval/question alerts follow the main desktop notification setting.

codexNotifier.localCacheRetentionDays.description: 本环境的通知采集缓存保留天数（1–30）。采集运行时清理过期元数据；原始 Codex 对话不受影响。 / Local collector notification-cache retention (1–30 days). Expiry runs while collection is active; original Codex conversations are untouched.

codexNotifier.historyRetentionDays.description: 本机共享通知历史及去重记录保留天数（1–30），默认 7 天，最多 200 条通知。旧版本缓存按文件修改时间清理。 / Local shared notification-history and deduplication retention (1–30 days). Default: 7 days, at most 200 history entries. Legacy caches expire using file modification time.

codexNotifier.language.description: 弹窗、日志及运行时界面的语言，独立于 VS Code 界面语言。更改后立即用于新提示；已有日志保持原文。 / Language for popups, logs, and runtime UI, independent of the VS Code display language. Applies to new messages immediately; existing log lines stay unchanged.
